Unknown ally answers «Тогда отходи!» around corner, signals three short metallic taps, footsteps withdraw. First infiltrator ~6 m from Shiki, oriented toward retreat, chakra gathering in hands; hidden second behind stair bend, no confirmed identity or position. No combat loss for Shiki. Infirmary entrance remains accessible. Around 12:24:30.
